subject: config: enable kernel-mode NEON and NEON AES/GHASH (#111)
author: Michael Ferguson

impact.effect_if_absent: On stock: no in-kernel NEON, so AES (dm-crypt, WPA CCMP fallbacks, IPsec) and GHASH (AES-GCM) run the generic C implementations on the Cortex-A9. On our image: none -- already set.

forward_port.effort: none -- kconfig only, already in our linux.config

notes:
OUTBOUND, like the 2026-09-14 increment: authored in this repo and sent upstream as fork PR #111 (head mcfbytes:config-kernel-mode-neon, merged 2026-10-05). scripts/check-fork-sync.sh cannot tell direction, so the record is the evidence that the upstreaming landed and that our image already has it.

MEASURED on the resolved output/build/linux-6.18.57/.config: KERNEL_MODE_NEON=y, CRYPTO_CRYPTD=y, CRYPTO_GHASH_ARM_CE=y, CRYPTO_AES_ARM_BS=y, CRC32_ARCH=y, and NHPOLY1305_NEON / BLAKE2B_NEON / AES_ARM_CE unset -- all eight as the fork sets them. ARM32-only symbols; the DE25 (arm64) has KERNEL_MODE_NEON unconditionally and is out of scope.
